name: musteri-onay-monorepo
description: Müşteri Onay ve Bildirim Yönetim Sistemi - Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WORKER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix worker run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix worker run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix client
